item.tib: zhang zhung yul gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dung shog dkar la g.yu ris btab/ chad slad med par gu ger brgyud/ nyes 'gal mkhyen brtse ldan la bshags/ dge ba'i bsod nams ci mchis pa/ mkha' mnyam 'gro drug don du bsngo/ gangs can bod la bstan pa yi/ mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzug par shog/
